title: CHORUS - Comprehensive HHT Outcomes Registry of the United States (Formerly OUR HHT Registry)
brief_summary: The goal of this study is to better understand HHT, the symptoms and complications it causes ("outcomes") and how the disease impacts people's lives. The investigators are aiming to recruit and gather information together in the Registry from 1,000 HHT patients from four HHT Centres of Excellence in North America. The Investigators will collect long-term information about the people in the Registry, allowing the investigators to understand how the disease changes over time, and what factors can influence those changes. Ultimately, this should help improve treatments for the disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants diagnosed with HHT by the Curacao criteria (either 3+ clinical diagnostic criteria or genetic diagnosis).
* Capable of giving informed consent in person or via a substitute decision maker
* \>18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants unable to give informed consent either in person or with a substitute decision maker
study_population: Subjects with Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT), living in North America
